texts: mixed: the query asks the right thing (the reason the Council meets, with the Council as the meeting's agent), but it pins the recurrence as a plain time slot 'full_moon' and drops 'every' -- 'at every full moon' is not one of the calendar slots the instruction set fixes (weekday, day-part, month name), so a statement of the same fact may instead store the recurrence as a per-occurrence rule with no such time atom, and then this question matches nothing. Make the recurrence an explicit occurrence clause that a statement and a question route the same way: "Why does the Council meet every time the moon is full?"
